source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "facial recognition" AND (police OR policing OR "public space" OR city)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"facial recognition" AND (police OR policing OR "public space" OR city),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("facial recognition" AND ("public space" OR "city" OR "police" OR "policing"))
